seo.title: ODDmembership — a year-round relationship with ODD
seo.description: ODD's year-round relationship for organisations that want ongoing access to the wider creative network, not just a single ticket or project.

title: A year-round relationship with ODD.
intro: Some organisations want more than a single ticket or a one-off project — an ongoing relationship with ODD and its wider network, across the year. "ODDmembership" is a working name for that relationship, still being defined.

whatItIs.headline: Not a ticket. Not a project. A relationship.
whatItIs.body: Where ODDagency is project-based and ODDference is a single event, membership is meant to be a standing relationship — regular contact with ODD's network and activity rather than a one-time engagement. The exact shape of what that includes is still being developed.

whoItsFor.label: Organisations wanting an ongoing creative connection
whoItsFor.description: Companies and institutions that want more than a single touchpoint with ODD's network.

whoItsFor.label: Partners already working with ODD
whoItsFor.description: Organisations already collaborating with ODD who want that relationship formalised year-round.

whoItsFor.label: Organisations exploring the creative economy
whoItsFor.description: Teams who want a standing way to stay close to what's happening in Finland's creative scene.
